name: kai-yt-music
description: YT Music client for KaiOS 2.5 — tests only; the app itself is plain browser JS (no build step)

scripts.check: for f in app.js sw.js js/*.js kaikit/*.js tests/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.webapp','utf8'))"
